01The last week of April 2024 saw another fine installation of a domestic wastewater treatment plant, the BC 4 OPTIMA…

The last week of April 2024 saw another fine installation of a domestic wastewater treatment plant, the BC 4 OPTIMA, this time in the beautiful foothills of the Novohradské Mountains.

The client had the site preparation perfectly organised: before we arrived on site, the pit for the WWTP had been dug, complete with a reinforced-concrete base slab. The pit for the soakaway was ready too, with 32/63 aggregate, all carefully wrapped in 200 g/m² filter geotextile. The client did all the excavation work by hand, which we greatly admire.

02Once again it was confirmed to us that it pays to give customers time and communicate with them before the work begins.

Once again it was confirmed to us that it pays to give customers time and communicate with them before the work begins. Installing and commissioning the technology is then far more pleasant when everything has been professionally prepared.

The BC 4 OPTIMA used here treats the wastewater. Downstream of it is a filter shaft with a removable filter basket. The filter shaft serves as a sampling point but, above all, protects the pore space of the underground soakaway from escaping sludge in the event of a process failure at the WWTP. The soakaway is built as a gravel soakaway pit into which DN 100 drainage pipes are laid. Treated wastewater flows out of the drainage pipes into the gravel, from where it infiltrates into the subsoil.
